config.GcLatency.name: Background GC
config.GcLatency.tooltip: While a save is loaded, run full garbage collections in the background instead of pausing the game. Restored when saving and on returning to title.
config.GcTransitionCollect.name: Clean Up Memory Overnight
config.GcTransitionCollect.tooltip: Run one full memory cleanup while the screen is black at the start of each day and after loading a save.
config.PreJit.name: Pre-compile Game Code
config.PreJit.tooltip: After launch, compile location, NPC and rendering code on a low-priority background thread so first visits stutter less.
config.AdjacentPrewarm.name: Pre-load Neighboring Tilesheets
config.AdjacentPrewarm.tooltip: After a warp, load the tilesheet textures of connected locations a little at a time. Usually a small gain, since maps load with the save. Skips assets that Content Patcher packs change on warps or clock changes.
config.SpikeDiagnostics.name: Frame Spike Log
config.SpikeDiagnostics.tooltip: Record slow frames, GC activity, warp times and save load time for perf_report.
config.InvalidationReport.name: Asset Invalidation Report
config.InvalidationReport.tooltip: Count reloaded (invalidated) assets per minute and per warp, and log a line when there are very many.
config.HandlerProfiler.name: Handler Profiler
config.HandlerProfiler.tooltip: Time every mod's event handlers to find slow mods (see Profile Mode). Also allows the perf_profile console command.
config.ProfileMode.name: Profile Mode
config.ProfileMode.tooltip: Continuous: time handlers whenever a save is loaded, for the session report. Manual: only during perf_profile runs.
config.AutoReport.name: Automatic Session Report
config.AutoReport.tooltip: Write the full report to Mods/PerformanceBundle/reports at each day end, every 5 minutes, on returning to title and when the game closes normally. Keeps the newest 10 files.
config.EnvironmentReport.name: Settings Check at Launch
config.EnvironmentReport.tooltip: Check SMAPI and runtime settings and Content Patcher packs once at launch and log tips. The perf_env command always works.
config.SpikeThresholdMs.name: Spike Threshold (ms)
config.SpikeThresholdMs.tooltip: A frame that takes longer than this is recorded as a spike. 60 frames per second is about 17 ms per frame.
config.InvalidationStormPerMinute.name: Invalidation Storm (per minute)
config.InvalidationStormPerMinute.toolti: Log a line when this many assets are invalidated within one minute.
config.ProfilerMaxOverheadUsPerTick.name: Profiler Overhead Cap (us per tick)
config.ProfilerMaxOverheadUsPerTick.tool: If continuous profiling costs more than this many microseconds per tick for 60 seconds in a row, it turns itself off for the rest of the session.
config.AdjacentPrewarmBudgetMs.name: Pre-load Budget (ms per tick)
config.AdjacentPrewarmBudgetMs.tooltip: Most time Pre-load Neighboring Tilesheets may spend per update tick. A single large texture can take longer.
